svg.title: The ontology sketch as a graph
svg.desc: A graph of the ARIAC ontology sketch. Teal class boxes: LiIonCell and NiMHCell on the left, each with a solid arrow to Cell in the middle. A magenta instance box, c1, sits between them, with a dashed arrow up to LiIonCell. Three gray relation boxes leave Cell: inSlot, with arrows to AGV and to Slot; testedBy, with an arrow to Tester; and partOf, with an arrow to Kit. At the top right, AGV connects to a gray relation box, atStation, with an arrow down to Station. A magenta instance box, inspection, has a dashed arrow up to Station.
